scope.evidence: Static dispatch and arithmetic source inspection, plus the existing frozen single-row RMS comparison.
scope.conclusion: The current Native replay and the selected Prefill paths do not share one arithmetic contract. These differences are not established causes of the complete trajectory error.

conditions: Launcher disables DSA CP and FlashComm1; the inspected target is an unsharded 8192-row Prefill norm.
Main MLA cache is BF16 (kv_cache_dtype=auto); indexer_kv_dtype=int8 is a separate cache setting.
q_a_proj, kv_a_proj_with_mqa and indexer.wq_b have W8A8_DYNAMIC recipes.

PROLOG_V3 selection additionally requires no dcp_group, no chunked q_proj, no TurboQuant, and a quantized indexer query when an indexer exists; these are source-selection conditions, not a captured per-layer runtime attribute.

For H=6144 BF16 and more rows than AIV cores, AddRmsNormBias has blockFactor>1, fits UB, exceeds merge-N and performance thresholds, and retains MODE_NORMAL (key 30). M=1 selects MODE_SINGLE_N (key 33).
Residual formulas below set beta=0. No learned ordinary RMS bias is assumed.
selection.prefill_rows_scope: Source-derived selection for an 8192-row norm; no kernel trace from this Prefill request.

notation.B: Round to BF16; F converts a value to FP32.
notation.U: F_ones(x), returned as BF16 by the current Native unit-gamma call.
notation.N_add: FP32 kernel sequence: square each element; multiply each square by FP32(1/H); ReduceSumCustom; add epsilon; sqrt; divide 1 by that result; multiply the original FP32 input by this reciprocal.
notation.N_prolog: FP32 kernel sequence: square; source-specific reduction; multiply the sum by FP32(1/H); add epsilon; sqrt; divide each input element by this result.
notation.Q_prolog: The cited Prolog DynamicQuant and CastFP32ToINT8 calls, including their returned token scale.
notation.boundary_scope: Formulas preserve dtype and operation boundaries. N_add and N_prolog retain their own source reduction order and device FP32 operations; they are not claims of bitwise equivalence to an ideal CPU formula.

contracts.location: First target-layer input RMS, with residual=None.
contracts.difference: Prefill supplies the learned gamma to one RMS operator; Native exposes the unit-gamma BF16 output before multiplying gamma. The existing input and q frozen samples demonstrate that these decompositions can differ.
contracts.limit: The ordinary API call does not by itself specify every internal CANN reduction or rounding instruction.

contracts.location: Post-attention RMS, later-layer input RMS, and final RMS.
contracts.difference: The 8192-row custom path normalizes the unrounded FP32 sum while separately storing BF16 residual. Native rounds the sum before its RMS call. Both paths already round the normalized value before gamma; replacing every Native norm with F_gamma does not reproduce this custom path.
contracts.single_row_exception: MODE_SINGLE_N casts the sum to BF16 and back to FP32 before its reduction. A one-row AddRmsNormBias check cannot establish the 8192-row residual contract.

contracts.location: qA H=2048 and kvA H=512 in SFA PROLOG_V3, full W8A8 and BF16 main KV.

native.q_a: npu_dynamic_quant(u_B) inside the next quantized projection

contracts.difference: Prolog carries projection dequantization into FP32 RMS and gamma multiplication without intermediate BF16. qA is then quantized from FP32; kvA is rounded to BF16 after gamma. Native materializes BF16 projection, unit-normalized BF16 and weighted BF16 values.
contracts.fallback: If preprocessing selects NATIVE instead, qA invokes q_a_layernorm and KV uses npu_kv_rmsnorm_rope_cache; this is a separate branch, not evidence that PROLOG_V3 uses those calls.

frozen_rms.reference: HF-style two-stage RMS on the saved single-row inputs.
frozen_rms.kv_and_post: Both decompositions matched those saved samples; this does not establish equivalence for other inputs.
frozen_rms.scope: No Prefill residual fusion or Prolog execution was exercised by this report.
